feeds_service


September 20, 2026


We were proud to join industry colleagues, students and future leaders at the[Women in Mining and Women in Nuclear Saskatchewan Inc. - WIM/WiN-SK](https://facebook.com/779609402120779) Mine Your Potential Conference yesterday. The event brought together people from across Saskatchewan's mining and nuclear sectors for a day of connection, learning and inspiration. We're especially proud of our own Monica Kwong, who served as WIM/WiN-SK Vice Chair and co-emcee, helping guide a day filled with meaningful conversations and valuable networking opportunities. Thank you to WIM/WiN-SK, the speakers, volunteers and everyone who helped make the event a success.
